rules.rationale: Base equation defining memberVS on the empty value sequence as false.
Structurally recursive memberVS equation for an unequal head; the simplification attribute exposes this defining case under its guard.
Equal-head memberVS equation defining successful membership; its simplification attribute is attached to a guarded defining case.
Defining appendUnique case that preserves the accumulator when memberVS reports the value already present.
Complementary appendUnique defining case that appends a value when memberVS reports it absent.
Base equation for the dedupFromVS recurrence, returning the accumulated sequence when no input remains.
Recursive dedupFromVS equation that consumes one input element and threads the appendUnique accumulator.
Base equation defining the retained loop-target value when the remaining sequence is empty.
Recursive lastFromVS equation that consumes a sequence head and carries it as the current loop-target value.

Its exact #memberAcc-to-memberVS reachability statement is first proved as MEMBER-SPEC.member-summary using the VERIFICATION-BASE definition, which does not contain this VERIFICATION-MEMBER rule; prove.sh then compiles the rule only for later stages.

Its exact loop body, continuation framing, local-scope update, and heap update are first proved as LOOP-SPEC.unique-loop using VERIFICATION-MEMBER, whose closure does not contain this VERIFICATION rule; prove.sh compiles VERIFICATION only afterward.
